summary: Completed testing of Formula Definitions API, Formula Parameters API, and Emission Calculation. All 13 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: Formulas page shows formula management with Add Formula/Parameters, Emissions page displays gas-wise breakdown (CO₂, CH₄, N₂O, CO₂e), Add Emission form shows calculated emissions preview with canonical formula details.

issues: Console warnings: HTML hydration errors with <span> inside <option>/<select>/<optgroup> - non-blocking but should be cleaned up for console hygiene

formula_definitions_api_get.details: Returns list of 2 formulas (CO₂ Emission Calculation, CH₄ Emission Calculation)

formula_definitions_api_post.details: Creates new formula with components, applies_gwp, gwp_gas fields

formula_parameters_api_get.details: Returns list of 4 parameters (Calorific Value, Quantity, Density, Emission Factor)

formula_parameters_api_post.details: Creates new parameter with standard_unit, available_units, unit_conversions

emission_calculation.canonical_formula: Base Emissions (kg gas) = quantity_kg × NCV_TJ_per_kg × EF_kg_gas_per_TJ
emission_calculation.details: Calculates and stores CO2, CH4, N2O, CO2e values correctly
